nodes.name: Landslide
nodes.description: Send a wave of earth toward enemies to root them in place.

nodes.name: Obsidian Scales
nodes.description: Harden your scales to reduce incoming damage for a short time.

nodes.name: Expunge
nodes.description: Remove poison effects from a friendly target.

nodes.name: Natural Convergence
nodes.description: Improve the channeling speed of Disintegrate.

nodes.name: Permeating Chill
nodes.description: Your blue spells slow enemies.

nodes.name: Obsidian Bulwark
nodes.description: Grant Obsidian Scales an additional charge.

nodes.name: Verdant Embrace
nodes.description: Fly to an ally and heal them, or heal yourself without moving.

nodes.name: Enkindled
nodes.description: Increase the effectiveness of Living Flame.

nodes.name: Quell
nodes.description: Interrupt an enemy spell and briefly prevent casting from that school.

nodes.name: Tailwind
nodes.description: Improve the movement speed bonus of Hover.

nodes.name: Scarlet Adaptation
nodes.description: Store a portion of your healing to strengthen a later offensive Living Flame.

nodes.name: Oppressing Roar
nodes.description: Roar in a cone to make affected enemies more susceptible to crowd control.

nodes.name: Cauterizing Flame
nodes.description: Cleanse harmful bleed, poison, curse and disease effects from an ally.

nodes.name: Draconic Legacy
nodes.description: Increase your maximum health.

nodes.name: Inherent Resistance
nodes.description: Reduce magical damage taken.

nodes.name: Bountiful Bloom
nodes.description: Allow Emerald Blossom to heal additional allies.

nodes.name: Overawe
nodes.description: Oppressing Roar removes an enrage effect and can recover sooner when it does so.

nodes.name: Renewing Blaze
nodes.description: Recover a portion of damage taken during its effect as healing over time.

nodes.name: Rescue
nodes.description: Carry a friendly player to a selected location.

nodes.name: Terror of the Skies
nodes.description: Deep Breath stuns enemies it hits.

nodes.name: Extended Flight
nodes.description: Increase the duration of Hover.

nodes.name: Foci of Life
nodes.description: Improve Renewing Blaze so its healing helps you sooner.

nodes.name: Twin Guardian
nodes.description: Rescue grants protective shields to you and the rescued ally.

nodes.name: Panacea
nodes.description: Emerald Blossom also heals you when used.

nodes.name: Leaping Flames
nodes.description: Fire Breath empowers a subsequent Living Flame to strike additional targets.

nodes.name: Aerial Mastery
nodes.description: Grant Hover an additional charge.

nodes.name: Ancient Flame
nodes.description: Using supportive healing spells makes a subsequent Living Flame faster to cast.

nodes.name: Blast Furnace
nodes.description: Extend the damage-over-time effect of Fire Breath.

nodes.name: Exuberance
nodes.description: Move faster while your health is high.

nodes.name: Unravel
nodes.description: Deal damage to an enemy's absorb shield.

nodes.name: Time Spiral
nodes.description: Allow you and your allies an additional use of a major movement ability during its effect.

nodes.name: Tip the Scales
nodes.description: Make your next empowered spell instant and cast at its maximum empower level.

nodes.name: Zephyr
nodes.description: Protect nearby allies against area damage and increase their movement speed.

nodes.name: Spatial Paradox
nodes.description: Temporarily allow you and a friendly healer to cast while moving with extended spell range.

nodes.name: Protracted Talons
nodes.description: Allow Azure Strike to hit additional enemies.

nodes.name: Fly With Me
nodes.description: Reduce the cooldown of Rescue.

nodes.name: Source of Magic
nodes.description: Link to a friendly healer so your empowered spells restore some of their mana.

nodes.name: Potent Mana
nodes.description: Improve the healing and damage of the healer benefiting from Source of Magic.

nodes.name: Chrono Flame
nodes.description: Replace Living Flame with a time-infused version that adds damage or healing related to the target's recent damage or healing.

nodes.name: Warp
nodes.description: Hover warps you through space and provides additional protection during the movement.

nodes.name: Temporal Burst
nodes.description: Tip the Scales grants a burst of haste, movement and cooldown recovery that fades over time.

nodes.name: Reverberations
nodes.description: Improve the time-based follow-up damage of your Augmentation abilities.

nodes.name: Temporality
nodes.description: Temporal Burst also provides a defensive benefit.

nodes.name: Motes of Acceleration
nodes.description: Warp creates acceleration motes that help allies move faster.

nodes.name: Threads of Fate
nodes.description: Empowered spells can create temporal threads that echo supported allies' output.

nodes.name: Primacy
nodes.description: Improve your haste through the use of empowered spells.

nodes.name: Double-time
nodes.description: Chrono Flame's temporal damage and healing can repeat.

nodes.name: Time Convergence
nodes.description: Improve the benefit provided by your time-based stat effects.

nodes.name: Instability Matrix
nodes.description: Empowered spells can reduce the cooldown of an empowered spell.

nodes.name: Golden Opportunity
nodes.description: Prescience can provide an enhanced support opportunity.

nodes.name: Temporal Compression
nodes.description: Casting non-empowered spells builds a benefit for your next empowered spell.

Evoker/Augmentation.description: Augmentation Evoker baseline based on remembered retail WoW talents, primarily from the Dragonflight / The War Within era. Not verified against Wowhead or current Midnight data. Positions, connections, ranks and summarized effects are editable approximations, not an official build. Uses this workbook's 34/34/4/13 point budgets. Hero section represents Chronowarden only; Scalecommander is not included. Apex is intentionally empty pending verified data.

nodes.name: Ebon Might
nodes.description: Increase the primary stat of nearby allies and strengthen your own damage. Your core offensive spells extend its duration.

nodes.name: Eruption
nodes.description: Spend Essence to erupt the ground beneath an enemy, dealing area damage and extending Ebon Might.

nodes.name: Upheaval
nodes.description: Empower an earthen blast that damages and knocks up enemies. Higher empower levels expand its area; it also extends Ebon Might.

nodes.name: Blistering Scales
nodes.description: Protect an ally with additional armor and reactive scales that explode when the ally is struck.

nodes.name: Essence Burst
nodes.description: Living Flame and Azure Strike can make your next Eruption cost no Essence.

nodes.name: Prescience
nodes.description: Increase an ally's critical strike chance and help prioritize them for your support effects.

nodes.name: Ricocheting Pyroclast
nodes.description: Improve Eruption's damage against additional nearby enemies.

nodes.name: Molten Blood
nodes.description: Blistering Scales also grants its target a protective absorb effect.

nodes.name: Power Nexus
nodes.description: Increase your maximum Essence.

nodes.name: Breath of Eons
nodes.description: Fly over enemies and mark them with Temporal Wounds. Damage dealt by supported allies contributes to a later burst against marked enemies.

nodes.name: Regenerative Chitin
nodes.description: Improve the durability and replenishment of Blistering Scales.

nodes.name: Accretion
nodes.description: Casting Eruption reduces the remaining cooldown of Upheaval.

nodes.name: Anachronism
nodes.description: Casting Prescience can grant Essence Burst.

nodes.name: Stretch Time
nodes.description: Improve the defensive benefits associated with Breath of Eons.

nodes.name: Seismic Slam
nodes.description: Enhance Upheaval's crowd-control effect.

nodes.name: Reactive Hide
nodes.description: Increase the retaliation damage of Blistering Scales.

nodes.name: Volcanism
nodes.description: Strengthen Eruption as part of your Essence-spending rotation.

nodes.name: Interwoven Threads
nodes.description: Reduce the cooldowns of your spells.

nodes.name: Timelessness
nodes.description: Reduce the threat generated by a friendly player.

nodes.name: Tectonic Locus
nodes.description: Improve Upheaval's damage against its primary target.

nodes.name: Fate Mirror
nodes.description: Allies with Prescience can echo a portion of their damage and healing.

nodes.name: Inferno's Blessing
nodes.description: Fire Breath grants supported allies a blessing that adds fire damage to their attacks and spells.

nodes.name: Draconic Attunements
nodes.description: Provide an attunement that improves the survivability or movement of nearby allies.

nodes.name: Time Skip
nodes.description: Channel to accelerate the recovery of your spell cooldowns.

nodes.name: Overlord
nodes.description: Breath of Eons also triggers Eruptions against enemies you fly over.

nodes.name: Dream of Spring
nodes.description: Allow Emerald Blossom to contribute to your Ebon Might extension gameplay.

nodes.name: Tomorrow, Today
nodes.description: Increase the cooldown acceleration provided by Time Skip.

nodes.name: Imminent Destruction
nodes.description: Breath of Eons temporarily improves the efficiency of your Eruptions.

nodes.name: Aspects' Favor
nodes.description: Obsidian Scales and Hover temporarily strengthen the benefits of your attunements.

nodes.name: Lush Growth
nodes.description: Improve your healing spells.

nodes.name: Motes of Possibility
nodes.description: Your empowered spells can create motes that allies collect to accelerate cooldown recovery.

nodes.name: Plot the Future
nodes.description: Your empowered spells grant a haste benefit that depends on how far they are empowered.

nodes.name: Symbiotic Bloom
nodes.description: Verdant Embrace leaves additional healing on its target.
